user.title: Set up Level Watch
user.description: All lengths are in cm. Thresholds and notifications follow in a later version.

data_description.name: Shown as device name, e.g. Rhine Cologne or Cistern.
data_description.source_entity: Sensor that delivers the level or the distance to the surface.
data_description.source_unit: Automatic uses the unit of the sensor. Choose one if the sensor has none.
data_description.kind: Water level (river, pond, well) or tank (cistern, heating oil).
data_description.measurement_mode: Level: the sensor reports the height of the surface. Distance: the sensor is mounted on top and measures down to the surface (ultrasonic, radar).
data_description.sensor_height: Only for distance measurement: height of the sensor above the reference zero (e.g. tank bottom).
data_description.offset: Added to every value, e.g. to correct the gauge zero.
data_description.reference_min: Level that counts as 0 % (empty or lowest level).
data_description.reference_max: Level that counts as 100 % (full). Leave empty for no percentage.

error.height_required: Distance measurement needs the mounting height.
error.max_below_min: The top reference must be above the bottom reference.
error.unit_unknown: The sensor has no length unit. Choose the unit manually.

advanced.name: Trend and data quality
advanced.description: Fine tuning; the defaults suit most sensors.

data_description.trend_window: Period over which the rate of change is computed.
data_description.trend_deadband: Rates within ± this value count as stable.
data_description.smoothing: Median over this period removes single outliers. 0 = off.
data_description.stale_timeout: Data counts as stale if the sensor reports nothing for this long.
data_description.max_jump: Larger jumps are ignored until 3 readings confirm them. 0 = off.
